record.label: Unpacked depth-5 arena memory boundary
record.summary: The prior depth-5 implementation projects above 8.8 GB and remains closed in its unchanged allocation form. Lifetime packing later reduced the measured official peak below 7 GB, so the old receipt is not a family-wide D5 impossibility proof.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed only for the unchanged unpacked arena. The materially different lifetime-packed successor is recorded under P2R0C1D16; no retry of this allocation is licensed.
